pages.text: Spirit Pulse is rhythmic beats, not furnace heat or FE. Drumhearts, Ley Collectors, and Pulse Resonators generate it; Pulse Cells carry it; lattices and Spiritgear spend it.
Use a Pulse Cell on a Drumheart or Pulse Resonator to charge up to 25 beats per click. Cells hold 200 and show a cyan bar.
Pulse Resonator burns coal or charcoal (~4 Pulse every 20 ticks while lit). Right-click with fuel, empty-hand for status, shift-click to pull unused fuel. Lattice Conductors treat it as a generator.
